scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a home loan and I'm just checking in on the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been purchased. Would you like to know more details about your loan terms?

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of this loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.125%. The total costs associated with the loan are $13,956.59. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features. The loan was purchased, but the purchaser type is not applicable in this case.

dialogue.user: Got it. Just one more question: What is my debt-to-income ratio and how does that affect my application?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income ratio is not present in your loan record. If you have any other questions about your loan, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user:
No, that covers everything I needed to know. Thank you for your help!

<Neutral> The information provided was clear and helpful, but I wish I had more details about the purchaser type and my debt-to-income ratio.
